page.layout: Printed page, one column of text. Top right: page number 76. Decorative woodcut ornament band at head. Title block centred (THEODORI BEZÆ / EPIGRAMMATŌN / LIBER / LECTORI), then an initial-letter poem in italic lines, a centred subheading "Ad eundem.", then a second poem in italic lines. Signature "K 4" at the foot right.

p.i: VNT qui Lectori longo fastidia libro Longa ferant, fas sit scribere pauca mihi.
Et tamen hic potuit, Lector, liber esse libellus: Pendere sed Versus non numerare decet.

NOn sævas metuo reprensiones, Non ronchos timeo, calumniasve, Non Syllos obelos severiores, Non quod Sel placeam mihi ipse stultus, Vel nullis stolidus calumniarum Confixus iaculis queam moveri: Sed quod si merito reprendar, adsit Quod possim mihi iure gratulari: Sin vero immeritum imperitus Syllus Carpat, inuidus aut sophista, quid tum? Istis maxima displicere laus est.

page.notes: The initial letters N (of "Non") and V (of "VNT") are large decorative initials. Some words are doubtful in the italic lines, notably "Sel" and "Syllos", which are copied as printed; "Vel" reads "Vel" in the scan. The decorative top ornament and the separator ornament are not transcribed.
